title: fix(spec): dashboard columns and bulk-param allowCreate texts say what the runtime does

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgT7HCvu6MdQGTH72Yw1Vm4R)_

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：搭建者和 AI 读到的两处规格说明改成与平台实际行为一致：仪表盘不写列数时按组件宽度自动取 4 列或 12 列；批量操作参数被拒时的提示，说明字段上的“允许新建”会带到批量弹窗。只有文字变化。
- 为什么做：替照规格说明写元数据的搭建者和 AI 解决“说明与运行不一致”，避免按“默认 12 列”布局却得到 4 列，或被告知“允许新建”带不过去。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是说明措辞仍有偏差，运行行为和校验结果都不变；撤回即恢复旧文字。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Four commits: one per card, then the CLI mirror of the #36913 sentence (fence widened by the zone) and a test-hygiene import. Text only: no runtime change, no change to any parsed shape or refused key set.

**#36913, `DashboardSchema.columns` describe.** It said `(default 12)`. The renderer (`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`, `inferredColumns`, ~L391–407 at 98bda0ac) has no fixed default: with `columns` absent it takes the widest `layout.x + layout.w` (or `layout.w`) over the widgets and returns 12 if that exceeds 4, otherwise 4. The describe now reads: "Number of grid columns. When absent, inferred from the widgets: 12 if any widget layout reaches past column 4 (x + w > 4), otherwise 4". TSDoc follows; `content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx` regenerated (`gen:docs`, the only stale artifact `check:generated` named). The `packages/rest` fixture that quotes the describe follows it, and the `os explain dashboard` table in `packages/cli/src/commands/explain.ts` now carries the same sentence. Because that rest test is edited, `check:test-source-alias` asked for its module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql'`; added.

**#36927, `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` prescription and `list.bulkActionDefs` liveness note.** PR #36919 made a promoted bulk def's field-backed lookup param carry the field's `allowCreate` (`resolveActionParams` copies it, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts` `toBulkParam` L191 forwards it). The prescription, its TSDoc, and the liveness note now list `allowCreate` with `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField`; the counts move from "four picker settings / six keys" to "five / seven". Every other key named is unchanged and still true on main (re-read in the same two files). The spec test comment that paraphrases the prescription follows it.

## Tests

Local, on 9a3c2894:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` · `check:generated` (after `gen:docs`: all artifacts current)
- `vitest run` on `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.test.ts`, `packages/rest/src/meta-types-schema-titles.test.ts` (3/3), `packages/cli` `test/explain-rule-id.test.ts` (14/14), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0
- the `dispatch-gates --commands` set for this diff; rows that need the whole workspace built exit 3 (prerequisite not met) and are NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI. 106 of 115 derived commands exit 0; 7 exit 3 (prerequisite); `check:test-source-alias` fixed and re-run green; `check:platform-checklist` red from main (see notes).

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/cli/src/commands/explain.ts:292` repeated "(default 12)"; the zone widened the fence and it is fixed here.
- `check:platform-checklist` is red locally on an ABSENT SYMBOL anchor (`FlowItemMoreMenu`) this diff does not touch; it comes from main.
- No `skills/**` page repeats "default 12" (grep at 98bda0ac).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `grep -n "columns:" packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` shows the inference wording; `grep -c allowCreate packages/spec/liveness/view.json` is non-zero.

Read first: `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` prescription hunk (the only place with wording risk), then `dashboard.zod.ts` L1822–1827.
